name: file_ops
description: File operations that are not reading or editing text: move, copy, delete, mkdir, stat and append. Pass op plus path, and to for move and copy, or content for append. Use edit_file to change what is inside a file and read_file to look at it; use this when the file itself has to move, go away, or be measured.

op.description: What to do with the path.

path.description: The file or directory to act on, relative to the sandbox root.

to.description: Destination path, for move and copy.
